# PokeFloat <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

</div>


```blitzbasic
PokeFloat:Void bank:Int32, offset:Int32, value:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bank` | In | Int32 | required | The bank to write to. |
| `offset` | In | Int32 | required | Position in bytes. |
| `value` | In | Float32 | required | The float to store. |

## Description

Writes a float in 4 bytes (IEEE 754 single precision).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
bank = CreateBank(4)
PokeFloat bank, 0, 1.5
Print PeekFloat(bank, 0)
Print Hex$(PeekInt(bank, 0))
FreeBank bank
```

```text
1.5
3FC00000
```
